senses.gloss: f. (חָיָה) revival; תְּחִיַּית המתים (abbrev. תה״מ) resurrection of the dead; also (= עולם הבא, לעתיר לבוא) hereafter.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 10:1">Snh. X, 1</cite> <he>האומד אין תה״מ מן התורה</he> he who says, the resurrection of the dead is not intimated in the Torah.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 39b">Kidd. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>אין לך כל מצוה … שאין תה״מ תלוייה בה</he> there is no command in the Torah accompanied by a promise of reward to which resurrection is not appended (which does not allude to reward in the hereafter); a. fr.
